title: Can AI Scientists Coordinate at Runtime?
abstract: arXiv:2610.00980v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent AI scientists have shown improving performance across a diverse range of tasks. Yet a common approach is design-time agentic orchestration, which typically relies on fixed workflows. In contrast, human scientists coordinate and adjust their division of labor at runtime. We therefore ask: can AI scientists also coordinate at runtime? To this end, we introduce Runtime Agent Coordination (RAC), which selects agents from existing AI-scientist hosts during execution, assigns scoped work contracts, and provides artifact-grounded verification. Verification informs subsequent agents without blocking transitions or discarding artifacts. We conduct a single-seed exploratory evaluation across Agent Laboratory, EvoScientist, and ARK on ResearchClawBench, preserving host models, tools, and permissions under host-calibrated budgets. translated_title: AI科学家能否在运行时进行协调？
translated_abstract: 多智能体AI科学家在多样化任务上展现出不断提升的性能。然而，一种常见的方法是设计时智能体编排，通常依赖固定的工作流。相比之下，人类科学家会在运行时进行协调并调整分工。因此我们提出问题：AI科学家也能在运行时进行协调吗？为此，我们引入了运行时智能体协调（RAC），它在执行过程中从现有的AI科学家宿主中选择智能体、分配有明确范围的工作契约，并提供基于产出的验证。验证结果会传递给后续智能体，而不会阻塞流程转换或丢弃已有产出。我们在ResearchClawBench上对Agent Laboratory、EvoScientist和ARK进行了单种子探索性评估，并在宿主校准的预算下保留了宿主原有的模型、工具和权限。四个累积条件分别区分了原生执行、运行时通信、运行时选择以及协同
tldr: 提出运行时智能体协调（RAC）框架，使AI科学家系统能够在执行过程中动态选择智能体、分配工作契约并进行基于产出的验证，从而摆脱固定工作流的限制，模拟人类科学家在运行时协调分工的方式。
